description: handle_mailbox_query hardcodes canCalculateChanges: true in the response (mailbox.rs:296). This claim is only valid if the backend can compute Mailbox/queryChanges for the same filter/sort. The implementation performs in-process filtering that backends cannot necessarily reproduce for queryChanges (they have no copy of the filter state). Any client that calls Mailbox/queryChanges expecting delta results will receive stale or incorrect data. Trigger: client calls Mailbox/query, then Mailbox/queryChanges trusting canCalculateChanges=true → incorrect delta.
title: Mailbox/query canCalculateChanges hardcoded true — false for in-process filter backends
